name: sensor_streaming
description: Phase 9 streaming workflow: periodically runs the Phase 7 availableNow sensor stream (Auto Loader -> live Bronze -> live Silver) with ADLS checkpoints. Fully independent of the batch pipeline (no ADF/DQ/Gold/Synapse dependency). Each run drains currently available files then terminates.

tasks.description: Structured Streaming (trigger(availableNow=True)): Incoming -> live Bronze -> live Silver, checkpointed on ADLS. Drains available micro-batches then stops.
